bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-public-buttons-9cfd59b"
compose="$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
image=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-public-buttons-9cfd59b
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 9cfd59bf11b3b813c44aed94926456669f4c7bfb
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
old_userbot=$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)
old_postgres=$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')
old_image=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
new_image=$(docker image inspect "$image" --format '{{.Id}}')
test -n "$new_image"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q
if test "$new_image" = "$old_image"; then echo ROOM_BUTTONS_ALREADY_DEPLOYED; exit 0; fi
docker tag "$old_image" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-room-buttons-20261113
docker tag "$image" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs; then
  docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-room-buttons-20261113 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs
  echo ROOM_BUTTONS_DEPLOY_ROLLED_BACK
  exit 75
fi
ready=no
for n in $(seq 1 30); do
  if test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true && docker logs --since 4m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then ready=yes; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if test "$ready" != yes || test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" != "$new_image"; then
  docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-room-buttons-20261113 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs
  echo ROOM_BUTTONS_UNHEALTHY_ROLLED_BACK
  exit 76
fi
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$old_postgres"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$old_userbot"
echo ROOM_BUTTONS_PRODUCTION=PASS
echo ROOM_BUTTONS_SOURCE=9cfd59bf11b3b813c44aed94926456669f4c7bfb
echo ROOM_BUTTONS_USERBOT_AND_DB=UNCHANGED
